subject: Logging & redaction controls — next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@fintechco.com>, Jenna Lee <jenna@fintechco.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Logging & redaction controls — next steps

Hi Samir / Jenna,

Great to speak with you earlier — thanks for walking through your integration pattern and the examples of PII you expect to see in request/response payloads. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary of what we heard
- You send transactions to Redwood for enrichment and summarization; request/response logs currently include full payloads, headers and trace IDs.
- Regulatory requirement: remove or mask direct identifiers (SSNs, account numbers) from persisted logs.
- Retention target: 13 months for searchable logs; short-lived request/response artifacts preferred for debugging.

Redwood capabilities relevant to this ask
- Ingress-side redaction rules (field-level masking at intake).
- Optional request/response logging toggle per route (on/off) + sampling rate.
- Automatic header scrubbing for common sensitive headers (Authorization, Cookie) and configurable header allowlist.
- Trace ID handling: can anonymize or replace with hashed/rotating ids for audit correlation without exposing raw IDs.
- Retention controls: default request/response logs retained 30 days; we can propose a contractual retention of 13 months for your account with access controls.

Requested from your side
- A representative sample (redacted) of logs or a small JSON payload that contains the fields you want masked so our infra team can validate redaction rules.
- Confirmation that 13 months retention for masked/searchable logs is acceptable.

Proposed next steps
1) I’ll schedule a 30-45 min technical deep-dive with Rafael (Engineering) to validate masking rules and go over the redaction-specs.xlsx we attached.
2) You send the sample payloads and the filled security questionnaire (if comfortable) so Rafael can validate.
3) We’ll produce a short design note showing exactly where and how fields are redacted and how trace IDs are handled.

Attachments: SOC2_summary.pdf (high-level), redaction-specs.xlsx (example mapping)

If that all sounds good I’ll send a calendar invite for the tech call — Rafael is available Thu or Fri morning PT.

Thanks,

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Samir Gupta <samir@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jenna Lee <jenna@fintechco.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Logging & redaction controls — next steps

Thanks Marissa — great call. Quick answers inline:

- Samples: attaching a small sample payload (PII redacted client-side) and our filled security questionnaire. We call out fields as account_number, ssn, and customer_email.
- Retention: 13 months for searchable/masked logs is what our compliance team requested. For full raw request/response we cannot retain more than 7 days.
- Trace IDs: we use distributed trace IDs for correlation; we’d prefer those hashed at ingestion so we can still map events internally but the raw trace value is not stored.

A couple of clarifying questions for Rafael:
1) Can Redwood apply field-level regex-based masking at ingestion (we have several variants of account numbers)?
2) For headers, are custom headers (x-fintech-session) scrubbed by default or do we need to add to an allow/deny list?

We’re good to have Rafael on a call Thursday 10:00 AM PT if that works for him.

Best,
Samir
Samir Gupta
Head of Platform Security | FintechCo
samir@fintechco.com

Attachments: security_questionnaire_filled.pdf, sample_payloads.json
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@fintechco.com>, Jenna Lee <jenna@fintechco.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Logging & redaction controls — next steps

Thanks Samir — appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. Rafael — looping you in as discussed.

Quick notes for Rafael before the call:
- FintechCo needs regex-capable field masking at ingestion; they have multiple account_number formats and want deterministic masking (same input -> same masked token) for debugging correlation.
- Retention split: 7 days raw, 13 months masked/searchable logs. Need an implementation plan that supports our RBAC controls.
- Trace IDs: preferred approach is hashing the trace id at ingestion with a per-account salt so FintechCo can still correlate their traces across requests but the stored value is not the raw trace id.
- Headers: default scrub list removes Authorization and Cookie; custom headers like x-fintech-session need explicit deny unless added to allowlist.

Proposed engineer agenda for Thu 10:00 AM PT (30 mins)
- 5m Quick intro & objectives
- 10m Review sample payloads and redaction rules (redaction-specs.xlsx)
- 10m Retention/archiving model and RBAC controls
- 5m Next steps & owners

If you can validate the regex engine we use (RE2) and confirm deterministic masking with per-account salt is acceptable, we should be able to meet their compliance ask. Rafael — can you take point on the technical validation and share any blockers before the call? I’ll send the invite shortly.

Links: logging/redaction docs: https://docs.redwoodinference.com/security/logging-and-redaction
HubSpot owner record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/FintechCo

Thanks,
Marissa

Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: FintechCo logging/redaction — pre-call checklist

Rafael / Monica — internal note ahead of the call with FintechCo (Thu 10:00 AM PT). Please treat as internal.

Context:
- FintechCo (deal FIN-2026-0894) needs field-level redaction, per-route logging toggles, and 13 month retention for masked/searchable logs. They will only allow 7 days retention for raw request/response. They also want trace IDs hashed with per-account salt.

Pre-call checklist for Rafael:
- Confirm RE2 support for their regex variants and any performance implications for ingestion at our expected qps.
- Prepare a short demo of deterministic masking (same input -> same masked token) and show how account salts are managed (KMS-backed).
- Validate header scrubbing config and how to add deny rules for custom headers (x-fintech-session).
- Prepare a short note on costs/impacts for 13-month masked log retention (storage + search indexing).

Monica — can you confirm commercial implications (pricing for extended retention + any contractual language needed for custom retention)? I’ll capture during the call and follow up with a proposal.

I’ll post meeting notes and the sample payloads we received into the HubSpot record after the call.

Thanks,
Marissa
